architecture.name: Field Integrity Shell A
architecture.active_layer: individually driven planar trim coils outside the blanket and vacuum boundary
architecture.passive_layer: flux-conserving superconducting loops for time-varying perturbations only
architecture.observability_layer: magnetic, coil-current, quench, cryogenic strain and support-motion sensing
architecture.mechanical_layer: warm-side modal damping and alignment surveillance
architecture.shielding_layer: geometry-aware graded shielding around REBCO and penetrations
architecture.plasma_facing_layer: segmented tungsten-family armor; no wall-confinement credit

harmonic_screen.coefficient_note: All challenge coefficients are synthetic multiples of 1e-4 B_axis, not measurements or a solved coil error spectrum.

modes.purpose: tri-lobe translation as a correction harmonic only

scenarios.description: All passive and active layers healthy.
One of 24 trim-coil channels is unavailable.
Sensor disagreement forces passive-only safe hold.
Passive loop is isolated; healthy active trim remains resource-gated and bounded.
An active trim-coil quench blocks all powered correction and leaves only healthy passive response.
Insufficient trim thermal margin blocks powered correction before a quench.
A pure time-varying challenge tests passive attenuation with active trim deliberately disabled.

donor_translation.AHIS: ADAPT observability, confidence-aware state estimation, watchdog and fault latching; REJECT hull-healing or direct plasma credit.
donor_translation.PressureX: ADAPT passive rate-dependent load shaping to warm supports; REJECT the donor impact model and any plasma-volume fluid.
donor_translation.IX-Vibe: ADAPT measured-mode targeting, shunt damping and alignment surveillance; REJECT broadband material as a field source.
donor_translation.IX-Breath: ADAPT resource gates, bounded states and safe hold; REJECT flexible-vessel breathing.
donor_translation.IX-GCR-SPE: ADAPT shadow-vault placement and graded protection around vulnerable magnets; REJECT space-radiation performance transfer.
donor_translation.IX-Shield: ADAPT weak-direction and areal-density bookkeeping; REJECT hydrogen-rich low-temperature material near the fusion core.
donor_translation.IX-HfTaZen-Shield: ADAPT segmentation, compliant interfaces and hotspot monitoring; REJECT Hf/Ta as routine plasma-facing armor.

claim_boundary.statement: Passing this screen proves only controllability of a synthetic linear harmonic challenge.

next_required_evidence: Replace the analytic response matrix with CAD-linked Biot-Savart responses including blanket steel and ports.
Solve free-boundary finite-beta equilibria and quantify island widths, effective ripple and strike-point motion.
Run guiding-center and alpha-orbit loss calculations before any confinement claim.
Run structural FEA with coil-support co-optimization and measured modal response.
Run 3-D OpenMC neutronics for WC/B4C/HfH candidate shields and REBCO lifetime.
Close trim-coil power, cryogenic, quench, radiation and failure-mode budgets in hardware.
